data.body: Bookkeeping correction: the "To append next" paragraph at the bottom of task 126 (number 125, finished) held three items recorded as investigation notes, not commitments, and none had a task, so they were invisible to the task list. Promoted them: id 133 (make a missed files.edit old_string actionable; still live at runtime/tool_loop/file_operations.rs:228, hit once in 31 edits in test1_qwen seq 56921 and three attempts in the first benchmark run), id 134 (settle the adaptive compression gates; qwen skipped 58 and fired 2), id 135 (a ~32k small-context variant, since no earlier run ever compacted). Task 126's own findings 1-5 were fixed: 1-4 in 1da66c8, 5 by the CoT passback 8248eee plus image dispatch b207144, verified in test1_3 at 64,192 uncached = $0.2890. Lesson: notes appended to a finished task are not tracked work; promote them before closing.
